subject: general
question: What is the new domain to which all banks must migrate by October 31, 2025, as per the directive of the Reserve Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**bank.in**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has issued a directive requiring all banks to migrate to the **new domain "bank.in"** by **October 31, 2025**.
 
• The move aims to create a **standardized digital identity** for banks across India and enhance the **security** and **trustworthiness** of their online presence.
 
• The domain **bank.in** is managed by the **National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI)**, ensuring reliable and secure domain registration under the **.in** country-code top-level domain (ccTLD).
 
• This migration is part of the RBI's initiative to strengthen the **cybersecurity framework** for banking institutions and improve customer confidence in **digital banking systems.**
 
• All Indian banks, including public sector, private sector, cooperative, and regional rural banks, are required to comply with this directive by the stipulated deadline.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Role of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI):**

 
 
• RBI is the **central banking authority** of India, established in **1935** under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.
 
• It is responsible for regulating the **banking sector**, managing inflation, and ensuring the **stability of the financial system.**
 
• The RBI regularly issues guidelines and frameworks to enhance the **digital infrastructure** and security of banks.
 
 
 
• **National Internet Exchange of India (NIXI):**
 
 
• NIXI is a non-profit organization that manages the **.in domain**, the official country-code top-level domain for India.
 
• It ensures secure and reliable domain registrations for entities operating within India.
 
• The **.in domain** is widely used for government, educational, and corporate entities, reflecting their Indian identity.
 
 
 
• **Cybersecurity Framework in Banking:**
 
 
• RBI has emphasized strengthening the **cybersecurity infrastructure** of banks through measures like domain migration, audits, and compliance checks.
 
• Ensuring secure domains like **bank.in** is crucial to preventing **phishing attacks** and unauthorized access.
 
• Initiatives like the migration to standardized domains align with global best practices in **digital banking security.**
 
 
 
• **.in Domain Characteristics:**
 
 
• The **.in domain** is India’s official ccTLD, symbolizing entities associated with the country.
 
• It is recognized globally and enhances the credibility of Indian businesses and institutions.
 
• Domains under **.in** are more secure and regulated, making them ideal for sensitive sectors like banking.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Deadline for Migration:**

 
 
• All banks must migrate to the **bank.in domain** by **October 31, 2025**.
 
• Failing to comply with the directive may result in **penalties** or restrictions imposed by the RBI.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Banks:**
 
 
• The migration will standardize the online identity of banks, making it easier for customers to recognize legitimate websites.
 
• It will also improve the **cybersecurity standards** of Indian banking institutions.
